videos.desc: In a hand-drawn animated office, a stern clerk rolls black ink over lines of a man's handwritten letter, cuts a piece off with scissors and drops it in a drawer, then hands him back the letter covered in black bars as he protests it was only news.
videos.said: That is my letter. This part must go. But it is only news. Not anymore.

videos.desc: A woman proudly drops her ballot into a voting box while officials watch, then joins volunteers picking up litter in a park, and finally stands beaming in front of a government building lined with flags.

At an animated naturalization ceremony in a bright hall, adults from many countries wearing green sashes receive rolled certificates from an official. A tearful man clutches his scroll, families hug, and everyone waves little flags and cheers.
videos.said: Welcome home, my friends. Welcome home, my friends. I belong here now. We are so proud!

videos.desc: In an animated marble hall, a politician demands more power; a wigged official lifts a huge old book from a glass case, opens it on the desk and points at the page, and the man reads it and deflates because the law says no.
videos.said: I want more power. Read this page. But I am powerful. The law says no.

videos.desc: A 3D-animated official at a marble office desk refuses to stamp a woman's paper, then rubs his open hand hinting he wants something; she reluctantly hands over a small pouch of gold coins, he pockets it, happily stamps the document and waves her off.
videos.said: Huh, big problem here. Something for me? Now it is perfect!

videos.desc: In an animated old town, a woman steps onto a stone balcony, unrolls a scroll and loudly declares to the gathered crowd that the new bridge is open; a bell ringer pulls the tower bell and the townspeople cheer and throw their hats in the air.
videos.said: Hear this everyone! The new bridge is open!

videos.desc: In a cartoon state boardroom a grey-haired leader in a purple suit points at a chart, calls a vote and stern ministers in suits raise their hands, then she presses an official seal onto a decree and the cabinet shakes hands.
videos.said: All in favor? Yes. Good. It is done.

videos.desc: In an animated town square, two rival candidates - a woman in an orange suit and a man in teal with a green rosette - stand on crates shouting "Vote for me!" while the crowd waves orange and green fans. Votes are painted as orange and green bars on a big board; the orange side wins a rosette, and the two candidates shake hands saying "Well done. Good luck!".
videos.said: Vote for me, friends! No! Vote for me! Yeah! Well done. Good luck!

videos.desc: A crowd marches through a sunny city square carrying green flags, sunflowers and hand-painted signs of a tree, a water drop, a sun and green hearts. They link arms, chant together and raise the signs while cafe guests watch.
videos.said: (upbeat music) - Hey, hey, hey, hey! - Sign's up, everyone! - All together, now! (cheering)

videos.desc: A soldier in camouflage chases a stranger away from his parked car, then struts and patrols around it swinging a wooden stick, pokes at the doors, climbs halfway through the window and tumbles onto the dirt road before laughing into the camera.
videos.said: Hey! Get away from my car! Move! Go! (laughing)

videos.desc: In a hand-painted anime scene a farmer hides a big wheel of cheese under the hay in his cart, calmly wheels it up to a border checkpoint where a stern guard pats the hay and raises the barrier, then behind the rocks he pulls the cheese back out and grins in relief.

In a grand marble hall, two animated leaders wearing sashes each press a wax seal onto a treaty document in front of their national banners, one teal with a circle and one orange with a triangle, then shake hands and pose side by side as their delegations applaud.
videos.said: My country signs today. Mine signs too. Two free nations. Friends.

videos.desc: Tall metal gates topped with coiled razor wire swing open at sunset. Men walk out one by one carrying their belongings in cardboard boxes, past a uniformed officer standing in the gateway. Families waiting on the road outside rush forward; a woman throws her arms around a grey-bearded man and sobs, and soon the whole road is filled with couples and families holding each other in the low orange light.

A comic sketch filmed outside a warehouse. A uniformed police officer stands behind a man dressed as a cartoon burglar — black and white striped suit and cap, black eye mask, a grey swag bag over his shoulder — and clicks handcuffs onto his wrists behind his back against a brick wall. As they walk, brightly coloured plastic gems and rubber chickens tumble out of the bag onto the ground. The officer then holds the burglar by the arm and walks him across the yard to a waiting police car and puts him in the back, with the film crew watching from the side.

Inside a polling station. An older woman with red glasses and a flowered scarf stands in a cardboard voting booth with a yellow pencil in her hand and a long printed sheet of empty boxes on the shelf in front of her. She frowns down the sheet, taps the pencil against her lips and looks up while she thinks, then bends over the paper and puts a firm tick in one of the boxes. She straightens up out of the booth with the paper and the pencil and smiles. A queue of other voters waits behind her in the hall.

A citizenship ceremony in a bright hall. A row of people stand side by side with their right hands raised, each holding a small Canadian flag, reciting after someone at a lectern. They lower their hands and hug each other. A man in a dark suit wearing a heavy ceremonial chain of office steps along the row and hands each of them a folded certificate tied with a ribbon. A woman in a yellow headscarf takes hers and cries. At the end she raises both arms and cheers while a seated audience applauds.

A marble ceremonial hall with a Turkish flag and rows of schoolchildren in uniform singing. A woman in a maroon suit and white cotton gloves carries a huge leather-bound book with a gold emblem and gilt corners to a wooden lectern and sets it down. She opens the heavy cover and turns the pages, showing hand-written calligraphic text inside ornate coloured borders. The last shot holds on the open book standing upright with a red wax seal on the stand in front of it.

A polling station set up in a school gymnasium. A clear plastic ballot box with a slot in the lid stands on a table, already half full of folded papers. A long queue of voters stretches back across the basketball court: an elderly man leaning on a white cane, a nurse in blue scrubs, a construction worker in a hi-vis vest and hard hat. Poll workers with red and blue rosettes hand out papers beside cardboard voting booths. A woman in a bright yellow raincoat walks up smiling, posts her folded ballot through the slot and punches the air.

A large group of soldiers in matching camouflage uniforms train together on sand and black mats under a grey sky. In the foreground a woman in uniform with her hair in a tight bun hits a black padded shield held by a comrade, her gloved fists up in a guard. Behind her rows of other uniformed soldiers work in pairs across the whole ground, and one lifts another clean off her feet and throws her over her shoulder onto the mats. The clip ends on the woman still punching, with dozens more soldiers drilling behind her.

An amateur football match on a worn grass pitch. A player in a dark maroon kit shoulder-barges a player in white off the ball and the white player goes down. The female referee in black points sharply at the offender. He turns to her with both palms raised, arguing and pleading that he did nothing. She raises a yellow card above her head; he keeps talking at her with his hands open, then walks off grimacing.

A wood-panelled office with a huge political map of Africa covering the back wall, stuck with coloured pins. A woman in a green suit sits behind a broad polished desk; a man in a dark suit stands beside her holding out an open folder, and she gestures with a rubber stamp in her hand as she speaks to him. An assistant with a tablet stands to one side while the man works at the map behind her. She signs a document, presses the rubber stamp onto it, closes the folder and sits back alone at the desk facing the camera.

Inside a large circular legislative chamber. A woman in a black suit stands among the seated members and raises her hand to vote. The camera pulls back to show the whole hall: hundreds of members in curved rows of desks, packed public balconies above, everyone standing and applauding. A man then speaks from the podium at the centre while the seated members listen.

At an airport border control desk, an officer in a peaked cap and uniform takes a passport, opens it on the black counter and inks a rubber stamp. He presses the stamp down and a large green tick appears on the page. The traveller lifts the passport up: the whole spread is covered in blue ticks, coloured stamps, little aeroplanes and a green cross. A woman in a yellow beanie then holds the stamped passport up to the camera, free to walk on, with the queue of waiting travellers behind her.

A woman in a red campaign T-shirt pastes election posters onto a city wall with a wide brush, smoothing down a blue poster with a candidate's silhouette; then two candidates in suits argue from glass lecterns on a brightly lit debate stage in front of a seated audience and a moderator; then, at a night rally, a crowd holds up red and blue placards, confetti falls, and a young woman in a red shirt cheers with her fist in the air.

In a big open-plan Japanese office full of identical grey cubicles, a woman in a company uniform climbs up and stands on top of her desk, glaring down at the room while the other workers sit at their screens. One by one the workers stop working: sheets of paper and a necktie fly up into the air as men and women jump to their feet and punch their fists upward. At the end the whole floor is standing between the desks with their arms folded, staring straight ahead at the camera while loose paper lies scattered on the carpet.

At an outdoor ceremony in front of a domed parliament building a woman in a dark suit raises her right hand and lays her other hand on a book held open in front of her while she speaks into a microphone. The crowd behind the barrier waves small red-white-and-blue flags and confetti drifts down. She then appears wearing a tricolour sash, waving to the cheering crowd, and finally turns on the stage and spreads both arms while photographers shoot from below.

Rows of young officers in dark green dress uniforms with peaked caps, gold shoulder cords and shiny buttons stand at attention and hold a salute, with rows of blue and yellow flags on poles behind them. The shot pulls back to a huge parade ground where hundreds of soldiers stand in straight blocks across the tarmac, a single officer in a beret out in front of them, while a crowd of spectators watches from behind steel barriers in the sunshine.

Row after row of young women in dark green dress uniforms with peaked caps, gold cords and white gloves stand shoulder to shoulder in a parade square, each row exactly level with the next. They all hold a salute with the white-gloved hand at the cap. The camera moves back over the block of them, showing a packed stand of spectators and a line of national flags on tall poles behind the formation.

A courtroom. An elderly judge in a red robe and white wig sits at a high wooden bench and reads a document aloud. A young man in a dark suit stands in the dock below her and stares up, shaken, as she speaks. She lifts a wooden gavel and strikes it on its block. A wide shot shows the packed court, barristers in wigs and gowns at their tables and a full public gallery.

In a green courtyard, two groups in business clothes meet at a long wooden table. A woman in a teal blazer and a man in a grey suit sit at the table with open document folders while four colleagues stand in a line behind them, two on each side. Two small desk flags, teal and orange, stand between the folders. The camera moves in as both sign their papers, then the two signers rise and shake hands while their groups look on.

A young man in a blue t-shirt with a backpack stands in a crowded government office, clutching a black document folder to his chest and staring ahead, tense. Behind a glass counter a woman in a navy blazer leafs through a booklet, then lays an open passport on a sheet of holographic security stickers and presses one into it. She slides the finished passport back across the counter. The young man opens it, sees the page, and breaks into a huge grin while the people waiting behind him hold up cards marked 10.

Inside a school hall set up with cardboard privacy screens, a clear plastic box already half full of folded white papers stands on a table. A woman in a yellow blouse posts her folded paper through the slot in the lid and smiles. A tattooed young man walks up the aisle holding his paper and drops it in, watched by the queue behind him. An older man in a striped polo shirt pushes his paper through the slot, then a woman in a wheelchair reaches up and posts hers. The queue keeps moving and an official sits at a desk beside the box.

In a community hall a clear plastic box stands on a folding table with a tall stack of folded white papers piled in front of it and more already inside. A woman in a mustard blouse steps up smiling with her hand on her chest. A young man in a white t-shirt pushes his folded paper through the slot in the lid, then an older man in a blue polo shirt posts his while the others wait and smile. A woman in a wheelchair holds hers ready and a helper in blue sits at the table. At the end the whole group stands around the full box, pleased.

In a snowy park two structures built out of stacked snow blocks face each other across an open field, each with thick walls, corner towers and a coloured flag planted on top — one blue, one red. Children and teenagers in red and blue winter jackets, bobble hats and scarves crouch behind the snow walls, then jump up and hurl snowballs, and clouds of white snow burst over the walls. The camera runs with them as both sides charge across the open snow towards the other side's snow walls; one child in blue is knocked over and rolls in the snow, another carries the red flag on a stick along the wall. At the end the whole group lies together in a laughing heap on the snow.
